en.text: “But now those who are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I considered unworthy to put with my sheep dogs.

zhSimplified.text: 但如今，比我年少的人戏笑我； 其人之父我曾藐视， 不肯安在看守我羊群的狗中。

zhTraditional.text: 但如今，比我年少的人戲笑我； 其人之父我曾藐視， 不肯安在看守我羊群的狗中。

en.text: Of what use is the strength of their hands to me, men in whom ripe age has perished?

zhSimplified.text: 他们壮年的气力既已衰败， 其手之力与我何益呢？

zhTraditional.text: 他們壯年的氣力既已衰敗， 其手之力與我何益呢？

en.text: They are gaunt from lack and famine. They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of waste and desolation.

zhSimplified.text: 他们因穷乏饥饿，身体枯瘦， 在荒废凄凉的幽暗中啃干燥之地，

zhTraditional.text: 他們因窮乏飢餓，身體枯瘦， 在荒廢淒涼的幽暗中齦乾燥之地，

en.text: They pluck salt herbs by the bushes. The roots of the broom tree are their food.

zhSimplified.text: 在草丛之中采咸草， 罗腾的根为他们的食物。

zhTraditional.text: 在草叢之中採鹹草， 羅騰的根為他們的食物。

en.text: They are driven out from among men. They cry after them as after a thief,

zhSimplified.text: 他们从人中被赶出； 人追喊他们如贼一般，

zhTraditional.text: 他們從人中被趕出； 人追喊他們如賊一般，

en.text: so that they live in frightful valleys, and in holes of the earth and of the rocks.

zhSimplified.text: 以致他们住在荒谷之间， 在地洞和岩穴中；

zhTraditional.text: 以致他們住在荒谷之間， 在地洞和巖穴中；

en.text: They bray among the bushes. They are gathered together under the nettles.

zhSimplified.text: 在草丛中叫唤， 在荆棘下聚集。

zhTraditional.text: 在草叢中叫喚， 在荊棘下聚集。

en.text: They are children of fools, yes, children of wicked men. They were flogged out of the land.

zhSimplified.text: 这都是愚顽下贱人的儿女； 他们被鞭打，赶出境外。

zhTraditional.text: 這都是愚頑下賤人的兒女； 他們被鞭打，趕出境外。

en.text: “Now I have become their song. Yes, I am a byword to them.

zhSimplified.text: 现在这些人以我为歌曲， 以我为笑谈。

zhTraditional.text: 現在這些人以我為歌曲， 以我為笑談。

en.text: They abhor me, they stand aloof from me, and don’t hesitate to spit in my face.

zhSimplified.text: 他们厌恶我，躲在旁边站着， 不住地吐唾沫在我脸上。

zhTraditional.text: 他們厭惡我，躲在旁邊站着， 不住地吐唾沫在我臉上。

en.text: For he has untied his cord, and afflicted me; and they have thrown off restraint before me.

zhSimplified.text: 松开他们的绳索苦待我， 在我面前脱去辔头。

zhTraditional.text: 鬆開他們的繩索苦待我， 在我面前脫去轡頭。

en.text: On my right hand rise the rabble. They thrust aside my feet. They cast their ways of destruction up against me.

zhSimplified.text: 这等下流人在我右边起来， 推开我的脚，筑成战路来攻击我。

zhTraditional.text: 這等下流人在我右邊起來， 推開我的腳，築成戰路來攻擊我。

en.text: They mar my path. They promote my destruction without anyone’s help.

zhSimplified.text: 这些无人帮助的， 毁坏我的道，加增我的灾。

zhTraditional.text: 這些無人幫助的， 毀壞我的道，加增我的災。

en.text: As through a wide breach they come. They roll themselves in amid the ruin.

zhSimplified.text: 他们来如同闯进大破口， 在毁坏之间滚在我身上。

zhTraditional.text: 他們來如同闖進大破口， 在毀壞之間滾在我身上。

en.text: Terrors have turned on me. They chase my honor as the wind. My welfare has passed away as a cloud.

zhSimplified.text: 惊恐临到我， 驱逐我的尊荣如风； 我的福禄如云过去。

zhTraditional.text: 驚恐臨到我， 驅逐我的尊榮如風； 我的福祿如雲過去。

en.text: “Now my soul is poured out within me. Days of affliction have taken hold of me.

zhSimplified.text: 现在我心极其悲伤； 困苦的日子将我抓住。

zhTraditional.text: 現在我心極其悲傷； 困苦的日子將我抓住。

en.text: In the night season my bones are pierced in me, and the pains that gnaw me take no rest.

zhSimplified.text: 夜间，我里面的骨头刺我， 疼痛不止，好像啃我。

zhTraditional.text: 夜間，我裏面的骨頭刺我， 疼痛不止，好像齦我。

en.text: My garment is disfigured by great force. It binds me about as the collar of my tunic.

zhSimplified.text: 因 神的大力，我的外衣污秽不堪， 又如里衣的领子将我缠住。

zhTraditional.text: 因上帝的大力，我的外衣污穢不堪， 又如裏衣的領子將我纏住。

en.text: He has cast me into the mire. I have become like dust and ashes.

zhSimplified.text: 神把我扔在淤泥中， 我就像尘土和炉灰一般。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝把我扔在淤泥中， 我就像塵土和爐灰一般。

en.text: I cry to you, and you do not answer me. I stand up, and you gaze at me.

zhSimplified.text: 主啊，我呼求你，你不应允我； 我站起来，你就定睛看我。

zhTraditional.text: 主啊，我呼求你，你不應允我； 我站起來，你就定睛看我。

en.text: You have turned to be cruel to me. With the might of your hand you persecute me.

zhSimplified.text: 你向我变心，待我残忍， 又用大能追逼我，

zhTraditional.text: 你向我變心，待我殘忍， 又用大能追逼我，

en.text: You lift me up to the wind, and drive me with it. You dissolve me in the storm.

zhSimplified.text: 把我提在风中，使我驾风而行， 又使我消灭在烈风中。

zhTraditional.text: 把我提在風中，使我駕風而行， 又使我消滅在烈風中。

en.text: For I know that you will bring me to death, to the house appointed for all living.

zhSimplified.text: 我知道要使我临到死地， 到那为众生所定的阴宅。

zhTraditional.text: 我知道要使我臨到死地， 到那為眾生所定的陰宅。

en.text: “However doesn’t one stretch out a hand in his fall? Or in his calamity therefore cry for help?

zhSimplified.text: 然而，人仆倒岂不伸手？ 遇灾难岂不求救呢？

zhTraditional.text: 然而，人仆倒豈不伸手？ 遇災難豈不求救呢？

en.text: Didn’t I weep for him who was in trouble? Wasn’t my soul grieved for the needy?

zhSimplified.text: 人遭难，我岂不为他哭泣呢？ 人穷乏，我岂不为他忧愁呢？

zhTraditional.text: 人遭難，我豈不為他哭泣呢？ 人窮乏，我豈不為他憂愁呢？

en.text: When I looked for good, then evil came. When I waited for light, darkness came.

zhSimplified.text: 我仰望得好处，灾祸就到了； 我等待光明，黑暗便来了。

zhTraditional.text: 我仰望得好處，災禍就到了； 我等待光明，黑暗便來了。

en.text: My heart is troubled, and doesn’t rest. Days of affliction have come on me.

zhSimplified.text: 我心里烦扰不安， 困苦的日子临到我身。

zhTraditional.text: 我心裏煩擾不安， 困苦的日子臨到我身。

en.text: I go mourning without the sun. I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help.

zhSimplified.text: 我没有日光就哀哭行去 ； 我在会中站着求救。

footnotes.text: - 30:28 或译：我面发黑并非因日晒

zhTraditional.text: 我沒有日光就哀哭行去； 我在會中站着求救。

footnotes.text: - 30:28 或譯：我面發黑並非因日曬

en.text: I am a brother to jackals, and a companion to ostriches.

zhSimplified.text: 我与野狗为弟兄， 与鸵鸟为同伴。

zhTraditional.text: 我與野狗為弟兄， 與鴕鳥為同伴。

en.text: My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat.

zhSimplified.text: 我的皮肤黑而脱落； 我的骨头因热烧焦。

zhTraditional.text: 我的皮膚黑而脫落； 我的骨頭因熱燒焦。

en.text: Therefore my harp has turned to mourning, and my pipe into the voice of those who weep.

zhSimplified.text: 所以，我的琴音变为悲音； 我的箫声变为哭声。

zhTraditional.text: 所以，我的琴音變為悲音； 我的簫聲變為哭聲。
